#rarefaction curves















```{r}
#plotting a rarefaction curve to justify subsampling size - tutorial found 20/05/2026 in project diary

#note: the initial code is for taking the otu out of the phyloseq object so vegan can compute it. It is a method taken from tutorial on 05/06/2026 in project diary

library(vegan)

 otu1_veg_format <- function(physeq) {
  OTU <- otu_table(physeq)
  if (taxa_are_rows(OTU)) {
    OTU <- t(OTU)
  }
  return(as(OTU, "matrix"))
}

#this step plugs otu1 into above:

otu_matrix <- otu1_veg_format(otu1)
  
#making the rarefication curve

rarecurve(otu_matrix, step = 20, cex = 0.5, label=FALSE)

abline(v=5000, col = "green", lty =1 )


```


```{r}
#a curve with rarefied data for comparison

library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)

rarefied_otu1 = rarefy_even_depth(otu1, rngseed=1, sample.size= 5000, replace=F)

 rare_otu1_veg_format <- function(physeq) {
  OTU <- otu_table(physeq)
  if (taxa_are_rows(OTU)) {
    OTU <- t(OTU)
  }
  return(as(OTU, "matrix"))
}

#this step plugs otu1 into above:

otu_matrix <- rare_otu1_veg_format(rarefied_otu1)
  
#making the rarefication curve

rarecurve(otu_matrix, step = 5, cex = 0.5, label=FALSE)

abline(v=5000, col = "green", lty =1 )

```


```{r}

#plotting a curve to show the sequencing depths below 5000

pruned_depth_5000 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(otu1) < 5000, otu1)

library(vegan)

 otu1_veg_format <- function(physeq) {
  OTU <- otu_table(physeq)
  if (taxa_are_rows(OTU)) {
    OTU <- t(OTU)
  }
  return(as(OTU, "matrix"))
 }
 
 pruned_5000_mat <- otu1_veg_format(pruned_depth_5000)
 
 rarecurve(pruned_5000_mat, step = 5, cex = 0.5, label= FALSE)

```


```{r}

#rarefying data that is only from the participants given FMT (the additional 10 patients do not have a day but are called "pre-FMT"). This object is assigned the name numeric-subjects and can be used if needed in the next analyses.

numeric_subjects <- subset_samples(otu1, day_relative_to_fmt != "pre-FMT")
```


```{r}
#rarefied data of all samples input to a basic shannon diversity plot comparing alpha diversity 


set.seed(1)
rare_otu1_shan = rarefy_even_depth(otu1, rngseed=1, sample.size= 5000, replace=F)

alpha_diversity_graph(rare_otu1_shan, treatment = "disease_state", subset = NULL,
index = "shannon", colors = "default")
```

```{r}
#A shannon graph that looks at only the rarefied post FMT samples and puts days along the x axis, generating a boxplot for each day. 

#rarefaction necessary.

library(phylosmith)
library(phyloseq)


shan_postFMT <- subset_samples(otu1, disease_state == "post-FMT")
shan_post_rarefied_otu1 <- rarefy_even_depth(shan_postFMT, rngseed=1, sample.size= 5000, replace=F) 

alpha_diversity_graph(shan_post_rarefied_otu1, 
                      treatment = "day_relative_to_fmt", 
                      subset = list(day_relative_to_fmt = "1", "10", "20", "30", "40"),
                      index = "shannon", 
                      colors = "default")

```









#beta diversity
- code for this way heavily inspired by code available to download from thsi tutorial https://micca.readthedocs.io/en/latest/phyloseq.html









```{r}

#ordination plot - unrarefied, all samples 

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)


bray_diss = phyloseq::distance(otu1, method="bray")
ordination = ordinate(otu1, method="PCoA", distance=bray_diss)
plot_ordination(otu1, ordination, color="disease_state") + theme(aspect.ratio=1)




```

```{r}
# rarefied, all samples

plot_ordination(rarefied_otu1, ordination, color="disease_state") + theme(aspect.ratio=1)


```

#abundance heatmaps (community changes)












```{r}

#CD1-4 + donor pre-FMT

library(phylosmith)
library(ggplot2)

filt_100_otu <- prune_samples(sample_sums(otu1) >= 100, otu1)

CD1to14 <- subset_samples(filt_100_otu, host_subject_id %in% c("Donor", "CD1", "CD2", "CD3", "CD4", "CD5", "CD6", "CD7", "CD8", "CD9", "CD10", "CD11", "CD12","CD13", "CD14"))
CD1to14preFMT <- subset_samples(CD1to14, disease_state == "Pre-FMT" | disease_state == "healthy")
                               

#making the heatmap (phylosmith function)

abundance_heatmap(CD1to14preFMT, classification = "Phylum", 
  treatment = "host_subject_id", subset = NULL, transformation = "log", 
  colors = 'default', treatment_labels = NULL, sample_labels = NULL,
  classification_labels= NULL)


```



```{r}

#CD1-4 + donor post-FMT

library(phylosmith)
library(ggplot2)

#filtering step

filt_100_otu <- prune_samples(sample_sums(otu1) >= 100, otu1)

CD1234 <- subset_samples(filt_100_otu, host_subject_id %in% c("Donor", "CD1", "CD2", "CD3", "CD4"))

CD1234postFMT <- subset_samples(CD1234, disease_state == "post-FMT" | disease_state == "healthy")
                               

#making the heatmap (phylosmith function)

abundance_heatmap(CD1234postFMT, classification = "Phylum", 
  treatment = "host_subject_id", subset = NULL, transformation = "log", 
  colors = 'default', treatment_labels = NULL, sample_labels = NULL,

```




```{r}
#seeing if i can isolate the initial days and look at the effect of taxa like Proteobacteria + filtering

#not used in final figures

library(phylosmith)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)

filt_100_otu <- prune_samples(sample_sums(otu1) >= 100, otu1)

initial_post <- subset_samples(filt_100_otu, 
                             day_relative_to_fmt %in% c("1","2","3","4","5"))

initial_post_proteobac <- subset_taxa(initial_post, Phylum == "Proteobacteria")

samples_before <- subset_samples(filt_100_otu, disease_state == "Pre-FMT")

samples_before_proteobac <- subset_taxa(samples_before, Phylum == "Proteobacteria")

merged1 <- merge_phyloseq(initial_post_proteobac, samples_before_proteobac)

abundance_heatmap(merged1, classification = "Phylum", 
  treatment =  "day_relative_to_fmt", subset = NULL, transformation = 'log', 
  colors = 'default', treatment_labels = NULL, sample_labels = NULL,
  classification_labels= NULL)
```




```{r}
#trying to see if i can see the species in the clostridium present, extending the days and merging with healthy to see if there are more conclusive results

#not used in final figures

library(phylosmith)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)

initial_post <- subset_samples(otu1, 
                             day_relative_to_fmt %in% c("1","2","3","4","5", "6", "8"))
initial_post_clostridium <- subset_taxa(initial_post, Genus == "Clostridium")

samples_before <- subset_samples(otu1, disease_state == "Pre-FMT")
samples_before_clostridium <- subset_taxa(samples_before, Genus == "Clostridium")
healthy_samples <- subset_samples(otu1, disease_state == "healthy")

merged1 <- merge_phyloseq(initial_post_clostridia, samples_before_clostridium)
merged2 <- merge_phyloseq(merged1, healthy_samples)

abundance_heatmap(merged2, classification = "Species", 
  treatment =  "disease_state", subset = NULL, transformation = 'log', 
  colors = 'default', treatment_labels = NULL, sample_labels = NULL,
  classification_labels= NULL)


```

#supplemetary tables




```{r}

#supporting the rarefaction curve figure

#is there a disproportionate amount removed from certain recipients after rarefication? 

#host id to read length in a table (cap at bottom ten maybe). Data frame explanation on 05/06/2026 helped
library(phyloseq)
library(knitr)

CD_reads <- data.frame (
    id = sample_data(otu1)$anonymized_name,
    origin = sample_data(otu1)$host_subject_id,
    depth = sample_sums(otu1),
    stage = sample_data(otu1)$disease_state
)
below_6000 <- CD_reads[CD_reads$depth <6000,]
sorted_below_6000 <- below_6000[order(below_6000$depth),]

#a table displaying the reads below and around 5000, capped at below 6000 (knitr is for knitting)

knitr::kable(sorted_below_6000)


```

```{r}

#looking at the cdiff reads only from post FMT in rarefied data

library(phyloseq)

rarefied_otu_2 = rarefy_even_depth(otu1, rngseed=1, sample.size= 5000, replace=F)
f_diff_only <- subset_taxa(rarefied_otu_2, Species == "difficile")

f_postFMT_diff_only <- subset_samples(f_diff_only, disease_state == "post-FMT")
f_cdifftable <- as.numeric(otu_table(f_postFMT_diff_only))
sorted_rarefied_cdifftable <- sort(f_cdifftable, decreasing=TRUE)

sorted_rarefied_cdifftable
```
